key_insight: A hybrid quantum-classical ensemble using QSVM and VQC can improve phishing detection in Ethereum transaction networks, with QSVM giving the strongest recall and lowest false negatives.
engineering_relevance: The study shows that QML can be practically applied to financial anomaly detection and may be useful where minimizing missed threats is more important than overall accuracy.
method: Compared QSVM and VQC on real Ethereum transaction data for phishing detection.
Used novel cascaded QRAC encodings and benchmarked them against the ZZ feature map.
Tested performance on both simulators and the IBM Heron quantum processor.
evidence_signal: QRAC improved performance over ZZ by about 13% for VQC and 3% for QSVM, and some models remained close to simulator-level results on IBM Heron.
watch_item: Despite gains, QML still trails state-of-the-art deep learning methods, and hardware performance can vary with device quality and quantum volume.
paper_title: Detecting Phishing in Ethereum Networks using Quantum Machine Learning
